posts.headline:
NEPAL MEIN GLACIAL COLLAPSE KA KAHAR:
669+ MAUT, 2400 GAYAB, NADIYON MEIN TSUNAMI!
posts.subheadline: Tibet border par pahaad tootne aur baraf phatne se aayi bhayanak flash flood. Bhote Koshi aur Trishuli nadiyon ne ujaad diye saikdon gaon aur bridges.
posts.caption: 🚨 Himalayan Catastrophe: Nepal me glacial burst aur avalanche se machi tabahi, 669 logon ki maut aur 2400 se zyada log laapata! 🏔️🌊 Nepal aur Tibet border par baraf aur pahaad ke achanak dhasne (ice-rock avalanche) se aisi bhayanak flash flood aayi jisne pahaadi ilaqon me sabkuch ujaad diya hai! Rasuwa, Nuwakot aur Chitwan ke zilon me Bhote Koshi aur Trishuli nadiyon ka jalstar achanak kai guna badh gaya. Hydropower projects, bridges aur mukhy highways paani ke sath beh gaye hain. Geological survey ke mutabik climate change ke chalte pahaadon par badhte temperature ne is glacial collapse ko trigger kiya! Pahadon par climate change aur natural disaster se bachne ke liye kya global action zaroori hai? Comment karein! 👇💬 Source: The Guardian & USGS Geological Report #nepalflood #glacialburst #climatechange #breakingnews #himalayas

posts.headline:
BHARAT BANA FIRST RESPONDER:
IAF KE C-130J SE 62 TONNE RELIEF MATERIAL RAWANA!
posts.subheadline: Indian Air Force ne banaya airbridge. Medical supplies, field hospitals aur hydropower tunnels me fase logon ko nikalne ke liye bheji expert team.
posts.highlighted_fact: 62 Tonnes Aid | IAF Airbridge | Tunnel Rescue
posts.caption: 🤝 True Neighbor: Nepal disaster me Bharat bana first responder, IAF C-130J aur NDRF ne shuru kiya massive relief operation! 🇮🇳❤️🇳🇵 Nepal par aayi is mushkil ghadi me Bharat ne sabse aage aakar padosi dharam nibhaya hai! Indian Air Force ke heavy-lift C-130J Hercules aircraft aur Mi-17 helicopters ke zariye 62 tonne se zyada relief material, drinking water purification kits, medicines aur field hospitals Kathmandu bheje gaye hain. Hydropower tunnels me dabi zindagiyon ko bachane ke liye Bharat ne specialized underground tunnel rescue engineers aur doctors ki team deploy ki hai, sath hi toote bridges ko jodne ke liye Bailey bridges provide kiye ja rahe hain! Bharat aur Nepal ke is atoot rishte par aapki kya rai hai? Pray for Nepal likhein! 👇🙏 Source: Hindustan Times & MEA India #operationmaitri #indiahelps #iaf #humanitarianaid #nepalrelief

posts.headline:
POST-DISASTER EPIDEMIC KHATRA:
BIHAR MEIN GANDAK BARRAGE KE 36 GATES KHULE!
posts.subheadline: Peene ke paani ki killat se waterborne bimariyon ka alert. Pahaadi highway cut hone se rashan sankat, Bihar prashasan ne downstream me badhaayi vigilance.
posts.caption: ⚠️ Post-Flood Crisis: Baadh ke baad Nepal me bimariyon aur rashan ki killat, Bihar me Gandak barrage ke 36 gates khol kar bachaav! 🚨🌧️ Nepal flood ke baad ab survivors ke samne sabse bada sankat peene ke saaf paani aur bimariyon ka paida ho gaya hai! Health experts ne cholera aur waterborne infections ki chetavani di hai. Dusri taraf Nepal se ufan kar aane wale paani se Bihar ke West Champaran aur Sitamarhi ko bachane ke liye Gandak Barrage ke sabhi 36 gates khol diye gaye hain taaki paani smooth flow ho sake. Emergency teams food drops aur chlorine tablets distribute karke logon ki survival ensure kar rahi hain! Is natural disaster ke samay har parivar ki safety ke liye satark rehna zaroori hai. Apni rai comment karein! 👇💬 Source: The Hindu & Disaster Management #floodcrisis #biharalert #survivalguide #epidemicprevention #disastermanagement
